analytics.name: Analytic 1797
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Impair Defenses from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes package management, DevicePolicyManager, or settings operations capable of disabling security tooling — API invocation to disable security control]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: MDM agent and approved Device Admin apps only. Any other app acquiring Device Admin then modifying security settings is Impair Defenses.
MDM agent, AV, MTD packages deployed on managed fleet. Derive from MDM enrollment configuration.
